description: European Medicines Agency referral procedures — EU-wide reviews of a medicine or class of medicines triggered by a safety concern, quality issue or scientific disagreement between member states (Article 31, Article 20, Article 107i and related procedures). Returns the referral name, INN, current status, whether it is a safety referral, procedure type, key milestone dates (procedure start, PRAC recommendation, CHMP/CVMP opinion, European Commission decision) and the referral URL. Answers "what EU safety referrals are open for X", "why was drug X reviewed by the EMA", "recent Article 31 referrals", "EU referral outcome for valproate".

query.description: Free text: referral name, INN/active substance, or associated medicine name.

safety_only.description: Only referrals flagged as safety referrals. Default false (all referral types).

since.description: Earliest procedure-start date. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY.

status.description: Filter on current status, e.g. "under evaluation", "procedure started", "European Commission final decision". Substring match.

name: ema_referrals
title: Ema Referrals
